linkedin.title: Most news apps are designed to make you panic
linkedin.body:
They rely on endless notifications and sensational headlines to keep you scrolling. It works for ad revenue, but it fails the reader. We built Headlinne because we wanted the opposite. We believe that being informed shouldn't come at the cost of your peace of mind.

Our philosophy is simple. AI should work for you, not against you. Instead of feeding you a firehose of breaking alerts, we use technology to filter out the noise. We focus on understanding what you actually care about, summarizing the context, and delivering it when you are ready to read. It is not about more news. It is about better news.

Building a calmer experience means respecting your time. It means stripping away the clickbait and the outrage cycles. We want to help you understand the world without needing to check your phone every five minutes.
